static_traits.name: Han Kailin
static_traits.social_status: Having a few friends to confide in,但因对娃娃收藏的not安全感,与朋友互动受到影响,谈及兴趣时常Self-doubt.
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness;既往without类似问题;not yet接受过心理治疗.
static_traits.language_features: Good cooperation, clear expression, steady speech rate, slightly nervous.

basic_info.main_problem: 我觉得我的娃娃收藏并not yet得到真正的欣赏,因为人们not喜欢娃娃,这使我对收藏的价值感到not安和怀疑.
basic_info.core_demands: 我决定寻求咨询,因为这些not安全感开始影响我的自尊和对爱好的享受.

core_beliefs: 娃娃收藏not被社会接受与欣赏

special_situations.event: 当她向朋友展示或谈论娃娃收藏时,朋友显得not感兴趣
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果他人(尤其是朋友)not感兴趣,就证明我的爱好一文not值,太幼稚
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Talking less about or showing one's collection less, avoiding related topics with others to avoid being evaluated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们not喜欢娃娃,所以我的收藏not价值;我是not是很幼稚

special_situations.event: 当朋友口头表示'挺好/not错'等礼貌性赞美时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果赞美not够热情或与我Anticipationnot一致,就一定是not真诚的
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly seeking confirmation and recognition from others
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are just brushing me off with nice words

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果同龄人大多not喜欢娃娃,就说明社会not认可娃娃收藏,我的爱好have not意义
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Questions the importance of his interests; reduces sharing and investment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 大家都not喜欢娃娃,我的爱好not重要

special_situations.event: 当她意识到身边几乎have not同龄人喜欢或理解娃娃收藏时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果身边找not到同好,将来也难被理解,我会一直是局外人
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 预先降低期待,Avoiding deep communication以免再次被negate
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: have not人会理解我,我可能一直都是局外人

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be genuinely accepted and recognized (hopes my interests are understood and appreciated)
core_conflict.fear: 害怕Being rejected,被当作幼稚或怪异,成为局外人
defense_goal: 通过避免谈论或展示收藏来减少被negate的风险
通过寻求外部认可以缓解not安
以'社会not认可'为理由Interpretation他人冷淡,从而Self-protection

object_relations.self_representation: not被理解的局外人,需要认可的爱好者

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked about others' feedback on her collection, or when others give polite praise
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将他人的中性或正面反馈理解为敷衍或not真诚(将内心的not认可Projection到他人)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Hesitant tone, repeatedly emphasizing 'they are just saying nice things', questioning positive feedback.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当咨询师或他人追问其not安全感的原因与意义时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 用'社会都not认可娃娃收藏'来概括原因,回避触及自身被接纳的渴望与脆弱
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Talks about 'social notions' in an objective, generalized tone, reducing expression of subjective emotions and needs.

manifestations: Feels like an outsider, believing few peers around like doll collecting
Feels coldly treated when sharing his collection with friends
难以与朋友谈论自己的not安全感与兴趣
outcomes: 回避谈论兴趣,Reduced socializing分享
Declining passion for and enjoyment of hobbies

positive_force: Passionate about the interest and invested long-term (has a large collection)
Clear help-seeking motivation; willing to join counseling and try new methods
Willing to explore online hobby communities to seek resonance and support
Still has several friends to talk with, with some support resources
negative_force: Overly reliant on external approval to assess self-worth
常见认知歪曲(灾难化,过度概括,negate积极,二分法)
在人际互动中倾向读心与Self-doubt,增加Social avoidance
Decreased self-esteem导致对兴趣的分享与投入减少

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids talking about or showing the doll collection
antecedent: When talking with friends about interests or preparing to show the collection
意识到朋友以往表现出not感兴趣
target_behavior.core_reason: 担心被negate与评价,认为娃娃收藏not被社会接受,从而产生羞耻与not安
target_behavior.function: 逃避Being rejected与负面评价,降低Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Reduced interaction with friends, limited sharing of interests, and decreased enjoyment of hobbies

target_behavior.behavior: Repeatedly seeks recognition and reassurance from others about the collection
antecedent: Getting a lukewarm response after showing the collection
收到礼貌性赞美但主观感到not真诚
target_behavior.core_reason: 自我价值感依赖外部评价,试图以外部认可缓解not安全感
target_behavior.consequence: 短期缓解但长期not改善not安全感,增加对他人反馈的敏感度与依赖
